answer: The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in haven, expire in saffron, and grove lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 199 aliases as a result needs 174 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 174 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
